caption: The request path of a MERN product page: React in the browser asks the Express route, which runs on Node.js and reads MongoDB. Notice that the 12 KB response is 20 products of 0.6 KB each, and that peak traffic of 8 requests per second sits well under the 40 requests per second the server can take.

spec.aria: Stack from React UI at top through Express and Node.js to MongoDB at bottom, labelled with 12 KB response, 8 requests per second peak, 40 requests per second max and 250 products.
